state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place) is under way.** Stage 3 is done: `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal in front of `goal-closeout`.

The `nvs-diagnostics`, `benches`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-db` and `nvs-ir` gap directories are closed for this goal. The other three `nvs-ir` gaps are owned by milestones M10 and M12. One `nvs-syntax` gap is left: `the-pipeline-bench-has-no-nested-twin`, a bench member, which is a different file set.

In `nvs-config`, `resolved` now skips the ancestors `Files::missing` rules out by a binary search, so a path with many missing folders costs a logarithmic number of filesystem calls (`crates/nvs-config/src/capability.rs`, its doc comment holds the argument). It searches on `missing`, never on `canonical`: on Windows a folder whose ACL denies reading it fails to canonicalize while a folder inside it does not. Pinned by `a_path_of_many_missing_folders_is_resolved_in_few_questions` and `a_folder_that_fails_to_canonicalize_does_not_hide_a_symlink_below_it` in `crates/nvs-config/tests/capability.rs`. The hostile case `02-a-path-two-million-folders-deep.nvs` now prints `denied` in under two seconds on a debug build. One `nvs-config` gap is left: `the-repository-nvs-toml-cites-adrs-not-rules`.

In `nvs-cli`, other subcommands' `--help` text was not swept and is still in the dense voice.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main` and the loop never pushes (`tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`'s module doc). A person pushes. No session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest of the gaps, across many crates. Smallest directories first: `nvs-server` and `website` (2 each), `vscode` (3), `nvs-cli` and `nvs-host` (4). Stage 4 stops on `BLOCKED` only for "too large", which the goal's § *Stage 4* defines. `bun nv import` is broken, because the rule index it reads was deleted. Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6. That is expected.

items.text: **The repository's `nvs.toml` cites ADR sections, not rules** — gap `the-repository-nvs-toml-cites-adrs-not-rules`, whose first rewrite is line 1's `ADR 0103 § 1 step 2` as the rule at `docs/rules/config/the-root-is-config-else-nvs-toml-else-the-shipped-defaults.md:1`. The root `nvs.toml` has about 35 citations: `grep -n "ADR" nvs.toml`, plus `0102 § 6` split over lines 4 and 5, and the bare `§ 7` and `§ 3` on lines 2626 and 2673. A rule's `because` list in `data/rules/<topic>/<rule>.json` names its records, and that is the map from a record to the rules it created. Send one `Explore` subagent for the map, one line per citation, then check each rule title yourself before rewriting. Rewrite each sentence whole as its `rule:` id (rule 7), and write the edits as one `bun nv splice --patch`. Delete `data/gaps/nvs-config/the-repository-nvs-toml-cites-adrs-not-rules.json`.

backlog: `nvs-server` and `website` gaps (2 each), then `vscode` (3) — `bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout`.
Other `nvs` subcommands' `--help` text in the dense voice — no record yet; file one under `data/gaps/nvs-cli/` if it is not closed in place.
`bun nv import` reads a deleted rule index — `tools/nv/cmd/import.ts`.
